# Climate Action - European Commission

> The official EU Climate Action portal providing comprehensive information on European climate policy, emissions trading, industrial decarbonization, and green financing initiatives.

This is the European Commission's primary platform for climate action, offering multilingual access to information about the European Climate Law, emissions trading systems (ETS2), carbon markets, hydrogen production, and funding mechanisms like the Innovation Fund and LIFE programme. The site serves as a central hub for EU climate policy, industrial transition support, and climate finance.

## Key Topics

- European Climate Law
- Emissions Trading System (ETS2)
- Carbon Markets
- Innovation Fund
- LIFE Programme
- Clean Industrial Deal
- Hydrogen Production
- Decarbonization
- Industrial Transition
- Climate Finance
- Net-Zero Targets
- European Climate Pact
- Green Industry
- Climate Adaptation
- EU Climate Policy

## Homepage & Language Portals

- [Climate Action - English Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_en): Main English-language homepage featuring ETS2, industrial support, and key climate initiatives
- [Climate Action - German Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_de): German-language portal highlighting emissions trading and EU climate funding
- [Climate Action - French Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_fr): French-language homepage covering carbon markets and transport decarbonization
- [Climate Action - Spanish Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_es): Spanish portal featuring European Climate Law and ETS2 developments
- [Climate Action - Italian Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_it): Italian-language homepage with industrial transition and carbon market information
- [Climate Action - Dutch Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_nl): Dutch portal covering carbon markets and Clean Industrial Deal
- [Climate Action - Polish Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_pl): Polish-language homepage featuring emissions trading and green finance
- [Climate Action - Portuguese Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_pt): Portuguese portal highlighting net-zero targets and hydrogen production
- [Climate Action - Czech Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_cs): Czech-language homepage featuring Innovation Fund 2025 and Clean Industrial Deal
- [Climate Action - Danish Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_da): Danish portal focusing on decarbonization and hydrogen production
- [Climate Action - Estonian Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_et): Estonian-language homepage with carbon markets and hydrogen production
- [Climate Action - Greek Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_el): Greek portal covering green industry and climate news
- [Climate Action - Croatian Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_hr): Croatian-language homepage with green transition and climate news
- [Climate Action - Hungarian Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_hu): Hungarian portal featuring emissions trading and climate finance
- [Climate Action - Irish Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_ga): Irish-language homepage with hydrogen production and carbon markets
- [Climate Action - Latvian Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_lv): Latvian portal highlighting hydrogen production and climate events
- [Climate Action - Lithuanian Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_lt): Lithuanian-language homepage with industrial transition and carbon markets
- [Climate Action - Maltese Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_mt): Maltese portal featuring Clean Industrial Deal and post-2030 targets
- [Climate Action - Bulgarian Homepage](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/index_bg): Bulgarian-language homepage with Innovation Fund and LIFE programme

## Language Selection

- [Select Language](https://climate.ec.europa.eu/select-language): Language selection page for accessing EU Climate Action portal in preferred language
